rows.text: Week 1: Phone is functioning fast. It's sturdy my first drop was off a park bench & onto concrete without a scratch. Nice phone. I love this phone I'm acualy writing this on it super smooth strong and kind of up to date as far as a 2 year old phone goes

Another great samsung phone. I bought this from another seller on release day - This is another great phone from Samsung. This is my 4th phone (I even had the Galaxy Note 7 for 2 weeks) and this is a great device. Pros *Infinity screen - nice for watching videos, as they will stretch to fit. Nice HD image! *Battery Life - Good, will last me ~2 days (my note 4 lasted only 1) *Sound - Internal speaker is much better than other generations and included ANK headphones are a nice bonus *Fast - Have over 100 apps on my phone and all are quick *Memory - Has 64GB memory which is nice vs the 32gb standard *Easy transfer - I was able to easily transfer everything from my old phone with no issues *Camera - Nice and crisp.

The phone is not as impressive as advertised. The .... The phone is not as impressive as advertised. The camera picture quality is very low when using the zoom function. It tremendously blurs the images. The phone slows down a lot as soon as I installed a couple of apps on it.

A 2 year payment plan is just stupid on this device, because it will never last that long without breaking. Many apps do not work right on this device because of the design of the screen and resolution. They just don't work right. There is nothing you can do until apps start developing specific patches and updates specifically for this device. Some work fine, many don't, or work until they crash constantly. The "Edge" screen functions are glitchy. A lot of times I am trying to click on the screen, and it pulls up the edge apps, which is annoying. BIXBY! what a joke. I wish I could disable the entire useless Bixby menu, and disable the stupid button from the side of the phone. I'm constantly accidently hitting that stupid button and have to get off that screen, or interrupting apps I currently have open.

I had a j7 pop and that phone worked better than this one. The product is for personal use and the quality has been poor: can't hear clearly, dialing another person takes 20 second to go through at times and it seems like the phone is just lagging.

Yes, I know, First World Problems... but is it entirely unreasonable to expect a newer device to be at the very least AS fast doing this as the previous model? I don't think so. My other gripe may not be an issue for many of you at all, but I can assure you for me it truly is. One of the many advantages Android has over iOS is customizing. I like several different keyboards and while the stock Samsung keyboard is okay, it is far from what I like--in fact I don't use it at all. I prefer GBoard, Swype and Swiftkey Flow. Before, if I wanted to switch from one keyboard to another while I was texting, as long as the keyboard was visible on the screen, you just swiped down from the top and the option to switch keyboards was right there.

Lots of PROs & minor CONs. A very solid 4.5 Stars This is just my review of the S8 Plus. I got mine through AT&T as my upgrade. I was trying to wait for the Note 8 but my Note 4 bricked when the power died during an update so I had to replace it with something fast. The S8 Plus is a really nice-looking phone and the camera is awesome. It's probably the best feature so far (I've had mine for about 3 weeks). I don't like that I can't replace the battery if I ever wanted to. The Bixby feature is somewhat useful but there is a bit of a learning curve to using it. I haven't been using it much but that's because I'm busy getting used to the rest of the phone. One thing that I really *don't* like about the phone is that it is slippery as an eel.

Best Phone Samsung Ever Made. I got my phone from Verizon in 2017. I've been using it since, with no complaints. I've mistakenly dropped it multiple times ( I have good quality covers) and it's still going strong... I'm not suggesting you deliberately dropp yours smile I multi task while on a call ( text, email, take pictures - anything - at the same time, I'm talking on the phone. I've run through a VERY LIGHT drizzle (rain), with it, and my Samsung was still functioning perfectly. Picture quality is very good. Buy this phone with confidence.
